# The Hugging Face CLI (`hf`) that the deploy steps install (ci.yml deploy-prod and staging.yml).
# It is pinned here, not inline in the workflows, so Dependabot's pip ecosystem can see it and
# propose bumps (.github/dependabot.yml; docs/engineering.md, "Dependabot"). The gate never runs an
# upload, so a bump PR for this file waits for review instead of auto-merging.
